acceptance_checks.given: an eligible Event enters Edit
acceptance_checks.then: it SHALL show the shared compound When surface and no native date input while preserving identity and title focus

acceptance_checks.given: canonical all-day [D1,D3)
acceptance_checks.then: Calendar and summary SHALL show inclusive D1 through D2

acceptance_checks.given: canonical timed multi-day or overnight start and end
acceptance_checks.then: both endpoint dates and wall times SHALL match exactly

acceptance_checks.given: no temporal edit or a title-only edit
acceptance_checks.then: the retained baseline start and end strings SHALL pass through exactly whenever the projection is semantically equal, including change-then-revert

acceptance_checks.given: Calendar range selection
acceptance_checks.when: one two reverse cross-month or third-click interactions occur
acceptance_checks.then: the existing live range contract SHALL apply and draft endpoints SHALL match without extra commit

acceptance_checks.given: valid date-only relative text
acceptance_checks.then: start and end dates SHALL shift by the same delta while span all-day state and times remain

acceptance_checks.given: valid relative date and time on a timed draft
acceptance_checks.then: naive wall-clock duration in whole minutes SHALL remain without DST reinterpretation and the endpoint SHALL handle overnight or multi-day rollover

acceptance_checks.given: valid relative date and time on an all-day draft
acceptance_checks.then: it SHALL discard the all-day span and become a synchronized one-hour timed draft with next-day rollover when needed

acceptance_checks.given: invalid relative text
acceptance_checks.then: localized guidance SHALL appear and no valid draft field SHALL change

acceptance_checks.given: an inclusive all-day range
acceptance_checks.then: canonical end SHALL be the day after the last visible date across boundaries

acceptance_checks.given: a timed same-day overnight or multi-day range
acceptance_checks.then: only malformed zero or backwards chronology SHALL block and valid endpoint wall datetimes SHALL serialize exactly

acceptance_checks.given: all-day toggles either direction
acceptance_checks.then: visible endpoint dates SHALL remain and canonical conversion or default times SHALL follow the spec

acceptance_checks.given: any field or Calendar selection changes
acceptance_checks.when: locale validation pending or Review draft rerenders
acceptance_checks.then: every unsubmitted value and range SHALL remain intact

acceptance_checks.given: en or pt-BR live switching
acceptance_checks.then: all visible and accessible copy SHALL localize without reparsing text resetting range or changing canonical data

acceptance_checks.given: an unchanged complete draft
acceptance_checks.then: the no-op contract SHALL perform no canonical mutation notification or grid refresh

acceptance_checks.given: Save is pending or fails retriably
acceptance_checks.then: duplicate commands SHALL be prevented and the full compound draft SHALL remain safe

acceptance_checks.given: a stale conflict
acceptance_checks.then: changed endpoint dates SHALL be detected the draft SHALL remain and conflict choices SHALL not write

acceptance_checks.given: Use latest or Review my draft
acceptance_checks.then: Use latest SHALL rebuild all When state baseline and token while Review SHALL preserve the complete draft and exact baseline and later Save SHALL use the fresh token

acceptance_checks.given: Cancel Escape Mod+Enter or Description Enter
acceptance_checks.then: original M2 non-mutation single-save newline and focus behavior SHALL remain

acceptance_checks.given: Google recurring or cancelled detail
acceptance_checks.then: Edit and its When surface SHALL remain unavailable and command rejection SHALL remain unchanged

acceptance_checks.given: Add Event task due Calendar Month Day Week detail Back and Time block flows
acceptance_checks.then: create single-selection timeline focus authority and linkage SHALL remain unchanged
